housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of EUR 851.75 for a one-bedroom apartment in Bolzano-Bozen city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Bolzano-Bozen). WAI reports an Italy-wide security-deposit norm of 1-3 months (https://www.waitaly.net/en/renting-in-italy/). No opened source established a main Bolzano rental portal.

banking.summary: Official pages confirm account offerings from Intesa Sanpaolo (https://www.intesasanpaolo.com/content/internetbanking/it/faq/common/faqHome/apertura-xme-conto-online.privati.html) and Bolzano-based Cassa di Risparmio di Bolzano (Sparkasse) (https://www.sparkasse.it/privati-e-famiglie/prodotti/conti-correnti/). Intesa states that a foreign resident needs an Italian codice fiscale and identifies new customers using an accepted identity document.

schools.summary: Campus Fagen in Bolzano is an authorized IB Middle Years Programme school; its Diploma Programme is only a candidate programme and is not counted as available (https://www.campusfagen.com/de/ausbildung/international-program.html). The Autonomous Province directory lists Bolzano state and paritaria upper-secondary schools (https://assets-eu-01.kc-usercontent.com/7ea6cc85-bc0d-01f3-7f75-32fd91efe5e0/acc9307f-98f2-4f3f-a471-100a069082f8/A4_Elenco_superiori.pdf).
curricula: International Baccalaureate Middle Years Programme (IB MYP)

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer who will live stably in Bolzano must submit a residence declaration to the municipal Registry Office; foreign citizens must also demonstrate lawful-stay requirements.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit a residence declaration to the Comune di Bolzano Anagrafe, online through SDO or ANPR or by the municipality-described PEC process.

tax_finance.summary: Foreign citizens obtain Italy's tax identification number, the codice fiscale, through the Immigration Desk or Questura in specified residence-permit cases, or otherwise by applying in person at an Italian Revenue Agency office; a first application requires an appointment and identity verification.

transport.summary: The official südtirolmobil Fix30 page gives EUR 39 per month for all public transport in South Tyrol (https://www.suedtirolmobil.info/en/tickets/ticket-finder/suedtirolmobil-fix30-pass). Italy's Transport Ministry explains licence rules (https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera). South Tyrol's CIVIS service directs eligible applicants to the administrative office of the health district nearest their residence (https://mycivis.civis.bz.it/de/Services/ServiceDetail/?id=1721).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences are treated as Italian licences and normally remain valid until expiry; non-EU/EEA licence holders may drive for one year after Italian residence with a valid licence plus an international permit or official Italian translation, then must convert where a reciprocity agreement exists or obtain an Italian licence by examination.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible newcomers apply to the administrative office of the South Tyrol Health Service district nearest their residence; eligibility and required documents depend on status.
